compiled_state.title: RED: Write failing tests for defense_store_load_for_region SHA-range membership validation and legacy fallback
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: integration test merges story A into the session branch, then queries DefenseStore.load_for_region from a final-PR-context session and asserts story A's attestations are returned (not stale-invalidated)
- DD2: legacy attestations without SHA-range fields fall back to diff_hash equality lookup with a logged warning
- DD3: Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Test Approach (SHA-range membership)
Given: a defense record stored with story_branch_tip_sha=<TIP> and story_branch_base_sha=<BASE>, and the current query context has a SHA in the ancestry path between BASE and TIP
When: defense_store_load_for_region is called
Then: the record is returned (SHA-range membership check passes)

Given: a defense record stored with story_branch_tip_sha=<TIP> and story_branch_base_sha=<BASE>, and the current query SHA is NOT in the ancestry path
When: defense_store_load_for_region is called
Then: the record is NOT returned (SHA-range check fails — invalidated)

## Test Approach (legacy fallback)
Given: a defense record stored WITHOUT story_branch_tip_sha/story_branch_base_sha (legacy attestation)
When: defense_store_load_for_region is called
Then: the record is returned via diff_hash equality lookup; a warning is logged to stderr containing "legacy" or "diff_hash"

## Implementation Notes
Create tests/review/test-defense-store-legacy-migration.sh covering:
1. SHA-range membership: record with tip/base SHA returned when query SHA is in ancestry
2. SHA-range exclusion: record NOT returned when query SHA is outside ancestry
3. Legacy fallback: record without SHA fields returned via diff_hash equality; stderr contains warning

Use a git fixture repo (git init in tmp) to create real commits for ancestry-path checks.
Pattern: use mktemp -d for temp git repos, not hardcoded paths.

Update .test-index with RED markers before committing:
- [test_load_for_region_sha_range_membership] for review-defense-store.sh
- [test_load_for_region_legacy_fallback] for review-defense-store.sh

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] tests/review/test-defense-store-legacy-migration.sh exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/review/test-defense-store-legacy-migration.sh
- [ ] Test file contains test_load_for_region_sha_range_membership function
  Verify: grep -q 'test_load_for_region_sha_range_membership' tests/review/test-defense-store-legacy-migration.sh
- [ ] Test file contains test_load_for_region_legacy_fallback function
  Verify: grep -q 'test_load_for_region_legacy_fallback' tests/review/test-defense-store-legacy-migration.sh
- [ ] Tests exit 1 (RED) before implementation
  Verify: bash tests/review/test-defense-store-legacy-migration.sh; test $? -ne 0
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED markers for both new test functions
  Verify: grep '\[test_load_for_region_sha_range_membership\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index && grep '\[test_load_for_region_legacy_fallback\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
